correctness.rationale: The exact isotropic normalization reduces to a conditional second moment and a probability exponent. A bounded-density local CLT under exponential tilting gives both limits. Differentiation of logF and a verified factorization yield B; the entire Taylor series of exp(2lambda) B has positive coefficients in degrees 5--8 and negative coefficients from degree 9 onward. Dividing by lambda^8 gives a strictly decreasing function with one zero, establishing global uniqueness. The source checker separately verifies 153 exact rational integrations and derivative identities; it is not used as an infinite-dimensional proof.
